record.context_brief: discrete subgroups with delta approaching one
record.original_question: Does there exist a sequence of discrete subgroups N_i <= Isom(H^3) such that each quotient H^3 / N_i has finite injectivity radius and the exponential growth rates satisfy delta(N_i) decreasing to 1?

evidence.quote: Question 4.5. Does there exist a sequence N_i <= Isom(H^3) of discrete subgroups with each H^3/N_i having finite injectivity radius and delta(N_i) downarrow 1?
A theorem of Gehktman says one cannot do better than 1 in the previous question, but it is not known if 1 is realizable.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{H}^3$ denote real hyperbolic 3-space, and let $\mathrm{Isom}(\mathbb{H}^3)$ be its full group of isometries. For a discrete subgroup $N \le \mathrm{Isom}(\mathbb{H}^3)$, let
$$\delta(N) \;=\; \limsup_{R\to\infty} \frac{1}{R}\log \#\{\gamma \in N : d_{\mathbb{H}^3}(o,\gamma o) \le R\}$$
denote its critical exponent (exponential growth rate), where $o\in\mathbb{H}^3$ is any basepoint. The injectivity radius of the quotient orbifold $\mathbb{H}^3/N$ is said to be finite if
$$\sup_{x\in\mathbb{H}^3/N}\mathrm{inj}_x(\mathbb{H}^3/N) < \infty.$$
It is known that for any discrete subgroup $N\le\mathrm{Isom}(\mathbb{H}^3)$ such that $\mathbb{H}^3/N$ has finite injectivity radius one must have $\delta(N) \ge 1$.

Question: Does there exist a sequence of discrete subgroups $N_i \le \mathrm{Isom}(\mathbb{H}^3)$ such that each quotient $\mathbb{H}^3/N_i$ has finite injectivity radius and the critical exponents satisfy $\delta(N_i) \downarrow 1$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in a 2023 problem session. Related work by Gekhtman (and Gekhtman–Levit) establishes the lower bound $\delta \ge 1$ in this setting, but the realizability of $\delta(N_i)\downarrow 1$ with finite injectivity radius does not appear to have been resolved in the literature found.

status_evidence.title: Critical exponents of invariant random subgroups in negative curvature
status_evidence.snippet: Gekhtman–Levit type results bound critical exponents of invariant random subgroups from below in negatively curved spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Provides the lower-bound side (cannot do better than 1) referenced in the question.

status_evidence.title: Stationary random subgroups in negative curvature (Gekhtman–Levit)
status_evidence.snippet: Discrete stationary random subgroups of isometry groups of Gromov hyperbolic spaces have full limit sets and critical exponents bounded from below.
status_evidence.claim: Background on critical exponent lower bounds; does not realize delta tending to 1.

status_evidence.title: Discrete subgroups of small critical exponent
status_evidence.snippet: Studies discrete subgroups with small critical exponent.
status_evidence.claim: Related work; no resolution of the specific realizability question found.
